items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: he did have this Swiss first girl, and she left him.

ctx.x: Chick was over in Europe. (Unintelligible), hell, he been in Europe way up (unintelligible) for a good while. Said, but this gal, so and so, so and so. Oh, man, said, now, that don't mean nothing, but, said, you hear so many stories of -- I just put it to rest. And --
I think, you know, he did have this Swiss first girl, and she left him.
